task.name: Support a percentage coupon in totalCents
task.description: Extend `totalCents(items, coupon)` in `src/cart.mjs` with an optional `coupon` of the form `{ percentOff }` (0-100). The coupon reduces the summed total by that percentage, rounded to the nearest cent (half up). With no coupon the result is exactly what it is today. Existing behaviour — including per-line half-up rounding — must not change.
steps: Add the optional coupon parameter to totalCents in src/cart.mjs
Leave the existing cart tests as they are

verificationCriteria.assertion: totalCents with a 10 percent coupon on 2 x 1000 prints 1800
